name: TC-AN-QB-005 — 批量填写：全部不合法（不写入表单）[P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea, .ant-input'); const badJson = JSON.stringify([{empId:'999999',empName:'不存在A'},{empId:'888888',empName:'不存在B'}]); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(textarea, badJson); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认')); if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasAllFail = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('成功 0 条') || t.includes('成功0条')); return { toasts: toastTexts, hasAllFail }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 粘贴全部不合法JSON（工号均不存在）\n3. 点击确认导入
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 不写入表单\n2. toast:「总计 2 条，成功 0 条，剔除 2 条：...」
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
